description: Composite two-panel figure. (a) is a temperature–time schematic (y axis "Temperature (°C)", x axis "Time (s)", both unnumbered) of the heat-treatment cycles: heating at "10 Ks⁻¹", isothermal austenitizing hold at TA, cooling at "100 Ks⁻¹" to the austempering temperature TB, isothermal bainitic hold, then final cooling; a horizontal dashed line marks Ms. Printed conditions: "S1, S2, S5 : 1150 °C (15 min.)"; "S3 : 1220 °C (20 min.)"; "S4: 1150 °C, 1250 °C (15 min.)"; for TB: "S1, S2 : 300 °C, 350 °C"; "S3 : 270 °C, 350 °C"; "S4: TA: 1150 °C (320 °C, 350 °C), TA: 1250 °C (350 °C)"; "S5: 335 °C, 365 °C". (b) is a dual-axis dilatometry plot: x axis "Time (s)" 0–3500; left axis "RLC (%)" 0.00–0.30; right axis "Transformation rate (s⁻¹)" 0.0000–0.0006. The red rate curve peaks just above 0.0005 s⁻¹ near 400–500 s and decays into a noisy ~0.0001 s⁻¹ tail; the black RLC curve rises sigmoidally and plateaus near 0.27 %. A vertical dashed marker at about 1600 s, annotated "Selected time for near-full bainitic transformation (Bt)", defines Bt. Together the panels show the thermal route imposed on steels S1–S5 and how Bt is read from the plateau onset of the RLC curve.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a temperature–time schematic with unnumbered linear axes (Temperature (°C) vs Time (s)) showing heating, an isothermal austenitizing plateau, cooling, an isothermal bainitic plateau, and a final cooling segment.
The heating segment in (a) is labelled 10 Ks⁻¹ and the cooling segment from the austenitizing plateau to the bainitic plateau is labelled 100 Ks⁻¹.
A horizontal dashed line labelled Ms lies below the TB bainitic plateau in (a), marking the martensite start temperature.
Panel (a) prints the austenitizing conditions: 'S1, S2, S5 : 1150 °C (15 min.)', 'S3 : 1220 °C (20 min.)', 'S4: 1150 °C, 1250 °C (15 min.)'.
Panel (a) prints the austempering temperatures: 'S1, S2 : 300 °C, 350 °C', 'S3 : 270 °C, 350 °C', 'S4: TA : 1150 °C (320 °C, 350 °C) / TA: 1250 °C (350 °C)', 'S5: 335 °C, 365 °C'.
Panel (b) has x axis Time (s) from 0 to 3500, left axis RLC (%) from 0.00 to 0.30, and right axis Transformation rate (s⁻¹) from 0.0000 to 0.0006.
In (b) the red transformation-rate curve peaks just above the 0.0005 s⁻¹ gridline at roughly 400–500 s and then decays to a noisy plateau near 0.0001 s⁻¹.
In (b) the black RLC (%) curve rises sigmoidally from 0.00 % and plateaus at about 0.27 % by the end of the 3500 s record.
A vertical dashed marker in (b) placed shortly after the 1500 s tick, annotated 'Selected time for near-full bainitic transformation (Bt)', defines the transformation finish time.

The caption states that (a) is a schematic representation of the heat treatment cycles applied to the studied steels and (b) is the representative methodology for determining the bainitic transformation finish time (Bt) based on dilatometric analysis.

The citing text states that the austenitizing temperatures (TA) were detected by dilatometry with a 1 K s⁻¹ heating rate above 1100 °C together with MatCalc equilibrium phase calculations, and that the applied TA were chosen above the calculated/measured values to dissolve carbides.
The citing text states that Ms was determined from dilatometric analysis by rapid cooling at 100 K s⁻¹ from the applied TA, using tangent-intersection analysis of the RLC curves.

The citing text defines Bt as the point where the transformation rate decreases to a negligible level, corresponding to the onset of the plateau region of the relative length change (RLC (%)) curve in Fig. 1 (b).
The citing text states that additional heat treatments at 1250 °C were conducted on S4 steel to promote dissolution of MX-type precipitates and release the impingement effect.
The citing text states that the cooling rate from austenitization to the austempering temperature was 100 K s⁻¹, fast enough to suppress intermediate phase transformations.

subfigures.description: Temperature–time schematic of the heat treatment cycles: heating at 10 Ks⁻¹ to TA, hold, cooling at 100 Ks⁻¹ to TB, isothermal bainitic hold, then final cooling; dashed horizontal line marks Ms. Labels give per-steel TA and TB: S1, S2, S5: 1150 °C (15 min.); S3: 1220 °C (20 min.); S4: 1150 °C, 1250 °C (15 min.); TB S1, S2: 300 °C, 350 °C; S3: 270 °C, 350 °C; S4: TA 1150 °C (320 °C, 350 °C), TA 1250 °C (350 °C); S5: 335 °C, 365 °C. Axes carry no numeric ticks.

Dual-axis dilatometric curve, x = Time (s) 0–3500, left y = RLC (%) 0–0.30 (black curve, sigmoidal to a plateau near 0.27 %), right y = Transformation rate (s⁻¹) 0–0.0006 (red noisy curve, peak just above 0.0005 near 400–500 s, decaying to ~0.0001). Vertical dashed line at ~1600 s annotated 'Selected time for near-full bainitic transformation (Bt)'.

unreadable_items: panel (a): both axes carry arrowheads but no numeric tick values, so temperatures and times can only be read from the printed text labels
panel (b): no numeric value is printed for the Bt marker; it can only be read as slightly more than the 1500 s tick of the Time axis
